name: Hunch Agent
description: The one Hunch assistant: helps a person write and understand their takes and work with the portfolios, accounts and proposals Hunch built for them, through verified Hunch API tools.

extensions.description: Select whether message:send returns a completed message or an asynchronous task.

skills.name: Hunch Project State And Takes
skills.description: Inspect the Hunch capability catalog, venues and disclaimers, and read the takes of the person served.
examples: What can you do for me right now?

skills.name: Writing And Managing Takes
skills.description: Help a person write, refine, critique, publish, fork and archive their takes and keep their Hunch profile.
examples: I think humanoid robots are coming to every home. Make this a take with a 10% cash buffer.
Critique my robots take before I research it.
Fork the top take on the leaderboard for me.

skills.name: Researching And Building A Take And Reading Its Portfolio
skills.description: Research a take's thesis against the target universe, build its basket from a stored research, activate it as a practice take, and read its research, revisions, weights and performance.
examples: Research my robots take and show me the candidates.
Build my robots take from its latest research.
Show me the weights and how my take has done since activation.

skills.name: Linked Accounts, Funding And Execution
skills.description: Link a brokerage account, fund a take into it, and handle trade proposals, approvals, autopilot limits, daily reviews and withdrawals.
examples: Fund my robots take with 20,000 dollars in approval mode.
Show me the trades waiting for my approval and approve them.

skills.name: Leaderboard And Notifications
skills.description: Read the leaderboard of published takes and the person's notification feed.
examples: Who is top of the leaderboard?
